structural_node_timing_provenance: Structural trace-only parents such as ROOT have no metric-bearing TC/T line; their local_time is therefore fixed to 0.0 rather than inferred.
communication_cost_provenance: 0.0 in this OpenCV calibration adapter because the profiled DNN calls execute in one process/shared address space and no byte-level IPC cost was measured; no byte volume is inferred.
overlap_gap_provenance: tgap=0.0 and async_eligible=false because the profiling campaign is intentionally single-threaded; parallel overlap is not inferred from sequential traces.
timing_provenance: Mean inclusive instrumented node time from five official OpenCV ENABLE_INSTRUMENTATION profiling runs for metric-bearing nodes only.
call_count_provenance: Mean observed dynamic child-call count from the same five instrumented runs.
measurement_boundary: The measured comparator is OpenCV native threaded execution on the identical fixed workload. It is an external real-runtime calibration of modeled-speedup magnitude, not a DTMC-GA-generated source rewrite.
